title: rung 4 measures the teeth a ticket removed from a proof renamed under an open ladder
intention: The tester's rung 4 finds the bytes its ladder bounded a proof to even when the proof was renamed since, so a ticket admits a seal over a renamed proof as it admits one over an edited proof.
why: Measured 2026-11-13: ticket 27e5f90dcfa7 was refused at rung 4 on cairn/devices/inferenceproxy/proofs/test_host.py (renamed from inference_domain by f942a413f26d): 'git holds no blob of cairn/devices/inferenceproxy/proofs/test_host.py hashing f2dd2cd1…'. _recorded_bytes runs git log without --follow, so the bounded blob, which git holds under the old name, is never found; the seal had to go through open-157cfd5052c0.
traces_to: Law 8 (rung 4 is the gate that measures a moved proof) and Law 1 (a rename git already records should not need a question to re-settle).
how: _recorded_bytes walks git log --follow --name-only, reading each commit's blob at the path the file had in that commit; a red-first proof renames a committed proof under an open ladder.

clauses.claim: a proof committed at an old path, its ladder bound to those bytes, renamed with git mv and edited under a code-seam ticket its PROVES names, lifts rung 4 (red on HEAD's reseal.py)
the same rename where the edit removed a tooth the proof does not name is refused, the refusal naming that tooth
a ladder hash git holds under no name the proof ever had is still refused as unmeasurable

decisions.text: D1: _recorded_bytes runs git log --follow --format=%H --name-only -- <rel>; for each commit it reads git show <commit>:<the path git printed for that commit> and returns the first blob whose sha256 is the ladder's. The caller's GIT_* stays dropped. Nothing else in reseal.py changes.

D2: the red-first proof cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_rung_4_follows_a_renamed_proof.py copies the scratch-git world of cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_rung_4_follows_the_ticket_kind.py (_git, a fixture code-seam ticket in a scratch tickets_dir), commits v1 at widget/proofs/test_old.py, binds the ladder to v1's hash, git mv's it to widget/proofs/test_new.py and commits, then edits; PROVES keys are this ticket's clauses 1-3, one tooth each.

out: every other tester code path; what rung 4 admits (outline 19.14.8.2)

measured.saw: 27e5f90dcfa7 refused at rung 4 on the renamed test_host.py: git holds no blob of the new path hashing the ladder's sha
measured.how: bin/cairn test --reseal with --ruling 27e5f90dcfa7 in worktree cairn-q95
